# NavisCoord

> Open-source coordination intelligence for Autodesk Navisworks Manage over
> MCP. It converts raw clash detection into explainable issues, root causes,
> work packages, reports and verified model workflows.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp
Latest release: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/releases/latest
License: MIT
Platforms: Windows; Autodesk Navisworks Manage 2024, 2025, 2026
MCP server name: horizun-navis-mcp

## Start here

- Beginner quick start: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md
- Full installation: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Security model: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md
- Testing evidence: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md
- Product benchmark: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md

## Product boundary

NavisCoord is not a general remote control and is not affiliated with Autodesk.
It focuses on BIM/VDC coordination: model discovery, search sets, clash tests,
clash compression, deterministic severity, root-cause analysis, coordination
plans, reports, handoff data and guarded Navisworks mutations.

Model data stays local. The Python MCP server talks to an in-process C# add-in
over a loopback-only, per-session authenticated bridge. Every mutation requires
explicit targeting and is verified by re-reading whenever the API supports it.

## Recommended first prompt

Verify NavisCoord without modifying the model. Then discover and analyze the
open Navisworks document, identify root causes, and produce a coordination work
plan in read-only mode.

## Development

- Python server: server/naviscoord/
- Navisworks add-in: addin/NavisCoord.Addin/
- Public profile example: profiles/example-profile.json
- Python tests: python -m pytest -q
- Add-in logic tests: dotnet run --project addin/NavisCoord.Tests -c Release
- Security reports: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/naviscoord-mcp/security/advisories/new
